stories.headline: Nvidia Blackwell GPU Rental Prices Surge 48% as AI Compute Crunch Intensifies

key_facts.fact: Ornn Compute Price Index shows renting a Nvidia Blackwell GPU for an hour now costs $4.08, up 48% from $2.75 two months ago
key_facts.excerpt: Ornn says renting an advanced Nvidia Blackwell chip for an hour now costs $4.08, up 48 per cent from $2.75 two months earlier, based on the Ornn Compute Price Index.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic has been hit by frequent outages and started metering supply during peak hours due to capacity constraints
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic, maker of chatbot Claude and the viral coding app Claude Code, has been hit by frequent outages. It has started metering supply during peak hours.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI scrapped its Sora video-generation app partly to free up compute for coding and enterprise products
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI scrapped its Sora video-generation app partly to free up compute for coding and enterprise products tied to a new model codenamed Spud.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI API token use jumped from 6 billion per minute in October to 15 billion per minute in late March
key_facts.excerpt: Token use in OpenAI's API, where mostly enterprise customers plug into the software, jumped from six billion a minute in October to 15 billion a minute in late March.

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave raised prices by more than 20% and is pushing smaller customers into 3-year contracts, up from 1 year previously
key_facts.excerpt: CoreWeave, one of the largest publicly traded AI cloud firms, raised prices by more than 20 per cent toward the end of last year. It has been pushing smaller customers into at least three-year contracts, up from one year previously.

key_facts.fact: Bank of America analysts argue GPU demand will outstrip supply through at least 2029
key_facts.excerpt: Bank of America analysts reinstated coverage late last month with a 'Buy' rating, arguing demand will outstrip supply through at least 2029.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar said the company is making tough trade-offs on products it can't pursue due to compute shortages
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI's chief financial officer, Sarah Friar, said, 'I do spend a lot of time trying to find any last-minute compute available. We're making some very tough trades at the moment on things we're not pursuing because we don't have enough compute.'

sources.title: AI Is Using So Much Energy That Computing Firepower Is Running Out
AI is fast running out of compute

stories.headline: SoftBank, Sony, Honda and NEC Launch Joint Venture to Build Japan's Own AI Foundation Model

key_facts.fact: SoftBank, NEC, Sony, and Honda have established a new company to develop large-scale domestic AI foundation models for corporate and industrial use
key_facts.excerpt: A consortium of major Japanese corporations including SoftBank, NEC, Sony, and Honda have come together to establish a new artificial intelligence venture aimed at developing domestically built AI technologies.

key_facts.fact: The venture plans to hire about 100 AI engineers, with SoftBank and NEC leading core model development
key_facts.excerpt: The venture will recruit around 100 AI engineers, give each lead member more than 10% equity.

key_facts.fact: Additional investors include Nippon Steel, Kobe Steel, and major banks MUFG, Sumitomo Mitsui, and Mizuho
key_facts.excerpt: Several major industrial and financial players, including Nippon Steel, Kobe Steel, and leading Japanese banks such as Mitsubishi UFJ, Sumitomo Mitsui, and Mizuho, are also participating in funding the initiative.

key_facts.fact: The consortium aims to expand into 'physical AI' for robotics control and autonomous driving, with Honda applying the technology in mobility
key_facts.excerpt: The consortium also aims to expand into 'physical AI,' enabling applications such as robotics control and autonomous driving, with Honda expected to apply the technology in mobility solutions.

key_facts.fact: The venture intends to apply for government-backed NEDO funding, which has allocated up to 1 trillion yen for domestic AI projects over five years
key_facts.excerpt: The venture intends to apply for government-backed funding from NEDO that totals up to 1 trillion yen over five years.

key_facts.fact: Preferred Networks, a Tokyo-based AI company, is expected to contribute engineers to the effort
key_facts.excerpt: Preferred Networks is expected to contribute engineers to the buildout.

stories.headline: Up to Half of Planned US Data Center Capacity for 2026 Faces Delays Due to Transformer Shortage

key_facts.fact: Sightline Climate report estimates 30% to 50% of approximately 16 GW of US data center capacity planned for 2026 will face delays or cancellations
key_facts.excerpt: According to the latest '2026 Data Center Outlook' report released by Sightline Climate, an estimated 30% to 50% of the approximately 16 GW of data center capacity planned for addition in the U.S. this year will face delays or cancellations.

key_facts.fact: Only about 5 GW of the 16 GW planned has actually entered the construction phase, while 11 GW remains at the 'announced' stage
key_facts.excerpt: Of this 16 GW of planned capacity, 11 GW remains in the 'announced' stage with no signs of construction.

key_facts.fact: Lead times for large power transformers have stretched from 24-30 months to 3-5 years, driven by competing demand from EVs, renewables, and grid modernization
key_facts.excerpt: Lead times that were once 24–30 months have stretched to 3–5 years for large power transformers. Prices have risen sharply.

key_facts.fact: Hyperscale cloud companies Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft have collectively guided for more than $650 billion in AI infrastructure capex in 2026
key_facts.excerpt: Tech giants — Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft — have collectively guided for more than $650 billion in AI infrastructure capex in 2026 alone.

key_facts.fact: The US imported over 8,000 high-power transformers from China through October 2025, up from fewer than 1,500 in all of 2022
key_facts.excerpt: In 2025 alone, the U.S. imported over 8,000 high-power transformers from China through October — up dramatically from fewer than 1,500 in all of 2022.

key_facts.fact: Looking to 2027, planned capacity reaches 21.5 GW but actual construction is only 6.3 GW
key_facts.excerpt: Looking toward 2027, the gap widens further. Announced planned capacity has reached 21.5 GW, but the actual scale under construction is only about 6.3 GW.

sources.title: Grand Ambitions, Harsh Reality! Nearly Half of U.S. Data Center Projects Slated for 2026 Face Cancellation or Delay
More than half of the Data Centers may be delayed due to lack of transformers and electrical equipment

stories.headline: Rolls-Royce SMR Signs Landmark UK Contract for Three Small Modular Reactors at Wylfa

key_facts.fact: Rolls-Royce SMR signed a landmark contract with Great British Energy – Nuclear (GBE-N) for the design and delivery of the UK's first small modular reactors
key_facts.excerpt: Rolls-Royce SMR has signed a landmark contract with Great British Energy – Nuclear (GBE-N) that paves the way for the design and delivery of the first small modular reactors (SMRs) in the UK.

key_facts.fact: Three 470 MWe pressurized water reactors will be built at Wylfa on Anglesey in North Wales, each powering approximately 1 million homes
key_facts.excerpt: Rolls-Royce SMR will build three units in the UK, each generating enough electricity to power 1m homes.

key_facts.fact: The project will support 3,000 jobs at peak construction and thousands more across the UK supply chain
key_facts.excerpt: The UK's first SMR project at Wylfa on Anglesey in North Wales will support around 3,000 jobs at peak construction and thousands more across the UK supply chain.

key_facts.fact: £2.6 billion was allocated in the 2025 Spending Review for the wider SMR programme delivery
key_facts.excerpt: Rolls-Royce SMR was selected as the preferred technology partner last June and £2.6bn was allocated in the 2025 Spending Review towards the wider programme delivery.

key_facts.fact: BAM Nuttall, Laing O'Rourke and Atkins are part of the consortium developing the SMR design
key_facts.excerpt: BAM Nuttall, Laing O'Rourke and Atkins are part of the consortium developing its SMR design.

key_facts.fact: Rolls-Royce SMR has also secured commitments for deployment in the Czech Republic and is in the final stage of selection in Sweden
key_facts.excerpt: Czech utility CEZ Group had signed an early works agreement enabling the launch of site work in Czechia for Rolls-Royce SMR to provide up to 3GW of low-carbon energy.

key_facts.fact: The contract is part of the UK's broader nuclear expansion targeting 24 GW capacity by 2050, including a £14.2 billion investment in Sizewell C
key_facts.excerpt: The UK government has also announced a £14.2 billion investment for the Sizewell C nuclear plant, part of its broader commitment to increasing nuclear energy capacity to 24 GW by 2050.

stories.headline: Over 70 Teams Complete Night Test for Beijing's Humanoid Robot Half-Marathon

key_facts.fact: Over 70 teams completed a full-scale overnight test from April 11 to April 12 at Beijing's E-Town Economic and Technological Development Area for the humanoid robot half-marathon
key_facts.excerpt: Over 70 teams have just completed night tests for the Beijing E-Town humanoid robot half-marathon. Autonomous running, remote control, and real race conditions were all put to the test.

key_facts.fact: Over 100 teams are registered for the official race on April 19, nearly a fivefold increase from last year, including four international teams
key_facts.excerpt: Over 100 teams are set to compete in the second humanoid robot half-marathon in Beijing.

key_facts.fact: The 21.0975 km course runs from Tongming Lake to Nanhaizi Park through city roads, racing circuits, and park terrain
key_facts.excerpt: The 21.0975-kilometer race runs from Tongming Lake to Nanhaizi Park, mixing city roads, racing circuits, and park terrain.

key_facts.fact: Approximately 40% of teams plan to run fully autonomously; those completing the race autonomously may qualify for a Guinness World Record
key_facts.excerpt: Teams that manage to complete the race fully autonomously may even qualify for a Guinness World Records entry.

key_facts.fact: Honor is entering two humanoid robots named 'Lightning' and 'Energetic Boy' featuring embodied AI with motion-control algorithms for high-speed movement
key_facts.excerpt: Honor, 'Lightning' combines its latest work in intelligent manufacturing with embodied AI. That includes motion-control algorithms designed for high-speed movement, along with real-time perception and decision-making systems.

key_facts.fact: The test simulated all key race scenarios including track navigation, equipment coordination, and emergency response
key_facts.excerpt: Autonomous running, remote control, and real race conditions were all put to the test as everything is stress-tested ahead of the official race on April 19.

stories.headline: China's Victory Giant Launches $2.2B Hong Kong Share Sale as AI Server PCB Demand Surges

key_facts.fact: Victory Giant launched a Hong Kong share sale seeking up to HK$17.49 billion ($2.23 billion), offering 83.35 million shares at a maximum price of HK$209.88 each
key_facts.excerpt: China-based Victory Giant launched a Hong Kong share sale on Monday seeking to raise up to HK$17.49 billion ($2.23 billion).

key_facts.fact: Shares are due to start trading on April 21 under stock code 2476; 74% of funds raised will expand production capabilities in mainland China
key_facts.excerpt: The shares are due to start trading in Hong Kong on April 21 under stock code 2476. The company said 74% of the funds raised in Hong Kong would be used to expand its production capabilities in mainland China.

key_facts.fact: Victory Giant ranked first globally by PCB sales revenue in AI and high-performance computing in Q1 2025, according to Frost & Sullivan
key_facts.excerpt: In its Hong Kong prospectus, it said it ranked first globally by PCB sales revenue in AI and high-performance computing in the first quarter of 2025, citing Frost & Sullivan.

key_facts.fact: Cornerstone investors will buy almost $997 million worth of shares, led by CPE Rosewood, Janchor Fund and Jack Ma's Yunfeng Capital
key_facts.excerpt: Cornerstone investors will buy almost $997 million worth of shares led by CPE Rosewood, Janchor Fund and Jack Ma's Yunfeng Capital.

key_facts.fact: The Shenzhen-listed shares surged roughly 583% in 2025 as investors piled into AI-related hardware names; the company was valued at about $37 billion
key_facts.excerpt: The Shenzhen-listed shares are up about 0.8% so far this year, after surging roughly 583.3% in 2025 as investors piled into AI-related hardware names.

key_facts.fact: Victory Giant is a key Nvidia supplier and also counts Intel, Tesla, Microsoft, and Bosch among its clients; profits surged 273.5% in 2025
key_facts.excerpt: Es un proveedor destacado para el fabricante de chips estadounidense Nvidia y también cuenta a Intel, Tesla, Microsoft o Bosch entre sus clientes. Victory Giant multiplicase casi por cuatro (+273,5%) sus beneficios el año pasado.
